entities.summary: The Domenareh Mosque is a mosque, located in Saqqez, Kurdistan province, Iran. It is one of the oldest mosques in Saqqez as well as Kurdistan, surviving in its original form. The mosque was completed during the Afsharid and early Zand eras.
